manufacturer_data.description: The app's broadcast parser requires the bytes 88 EC in the manufacturer-specific AD structure (= company 0xEC88 / 60552 when they lead the payload), with a 2-byte big-endian goodsType after them. A leading version byte on newer firmware shifts them to payload offset 1, making hosts report 0x88XX instead — match on the bytes, not the parsed company id. Unverified on the air for this discontinued pair specifically — no capture records their exact advertisement layout.

Bytes 88 EC in the manufacturer-specific AD structure — company 0xEC88 / 60552 when they lead the payload, 0x88XX when a leading broadcast-version byte shifts them to offset 1 (0x8802, 0x8803, 0x8843 seen on Govee lights 2026-08-22). Not verified on the air for this discontinued pair; see the discovery block.

device.name: Govee H6101/H6104 TV Backlight
device.notes: Early BLE-only TV backlight strips (both discontinued; the app still carries their modules). This is the ONLY Govee light family on the legacy 0xFFE0/0xFFE1 GATT profile — every other family, from the H6001 bulb to current RGBIC strips, uses service 00010203-0405-0607-0809- 0a0b0c0d1910 with characteristic …2b11. The wire protocol itself is the same 20-byte fixed packet as the rest of the family: byte 0 = 0x33 (control) / 0xAA (query), byte 19 = XOR of bytes 0-18. GROUP CONTROL: the app's group-control helper writes to 0xFFE1 under 0xFFE0 for these two models specifically; for all other families it uses the standard …2b11 characteristic, falling back to FFE0/FFE1 only when the 1910 service is absent. COMMAND SET: power (33 01), brightness (33 04), color/mode (33 05) with the legacy sub-modes (0x02 manual RGB, 0x04 scene, 0x0A DIY, 0x11 music). Query variants under 0xAA. Keep-alive AA 01 every ~2 s while connected, as on all Govee BLE lights. CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM. The GATT profile and framing are app-confirmed; no independent on-device capture of this pair is known to us, and the advertised name form is unconfirmed (contemporary Govee gear advertises ihoment_<model>_<hex>; Minger-branded units exist).

credentials.notes: BLE-only; no WiFi passphrase crosses the link. Open writes from any connected central are accepted.

factory_reset.description:
The same power-cycle gesture Govee use across their lighting range, and the confirmation is the same: the light flashes and then settles into the slow breathing pattern the app looks for.
On a backlight strip that means cycling whatever it is plugged into — the switched outlet or the controller's own inline switch — rather than looking for a button on the strip, which does not have one.
factory_reset.effect: Clears the pairing and returns the strip to its advertising state so it can be added again as a new device. Nothing else is stored on it.

procedures.basis: Govee's published user documentation for the lighting range.
procedures.indicator: The strip flashes, then breathes slowly.
procedures.name: Power-cycle five times

steps.action: Switch the strip off and on five times in quick succession at whatever controls its power.
steps.expect: The strip flashes and then breathes — it is unpaired and discoverable.

methods.description: No provisioning needed. Power on, scan, connect, write.

steps.action: Power the strip and scan for BLE advertisements.
Connect and write control commands to 0xFFE1.

setup.notes: No pairing or bonding required. BLE-only devices; they advertise on power-up and accept open writes from any connected central.

rejoin.notes: BLE-only; joins no network. No bond is held: any central may connect once the previous one disconnects.

get_brightness.description: Query brightness; response payload byte 0 = 0-100. Packet: [0xAA, 0x04, 0x00*17, <xor>]

get_mode.description: Query current mode; response payload byte 0 = sub-mode, remainder = sub-mode state. Packet: [0xAA, 0x05, 0x00*17, <xor>]

get_power_state.description: Query power; response payload byte 0 = power. Packet: [0xAA, 0x01, 0x00*17, <xor>] — the same frame the keep-alive sends.

keep_alive.description: Connection keep-alive, sent every ~2 s. Packet: [0xAA, 0x01, 0x00*17, 0xAB]

brightness.notes: Percent, matching the shared light-stack controller in the app.

checksum.description: XOR of the preceding 19 frame bytes; encoder-filled, never a control.

set_color.description: Set RGB color (mode byte 0x02 = manual). Packet: [0x33, 0x05, 0x02, <R>, <G>, <B>, 0x00*13, <xor>]

checksum.description: XOR of the preceding 19 frame bytes; encoder-filled, never a control.

set_scene.description: Apply a built-in scene. Packet: [0x33, 0x05, 0x04, <id_lo>, <id_hi>, 0x00*14, <xor>] — 16-bit little-endian scene id.

checksum.description: XOR of the preceding 19 frame bytes; encoder-filled, never a control.

scene_hi.notes: High byte of the 16-bit scene id (0 for all built-in scenes).

scene_lo.notes: Low byte of the 16-bit scene id.

characteristics.name: Control Write/Notify
characteristics.notes: Single characteristic for commands, ACKs and the app's group control writes. Write ACKs echo the command id with payload byte 0 = 0 on success.

services.name: Govee Legacy Backlight Service
services.notes: Vendor-specific 16-bit-alias service used only by the H6101/H6104 pair (app-confirmed). All commands are 20-byte fixed-length packets, byte 19 = XOR of bytes 0-18. The app sends keep-alive AA 01 00..00 AB every ~2 s while connected.
